description:
Parent: fz-f98. RESOLVED at main 417c5b0b5.

## What this reported

A body with three Range `Enum.reduce/2` calls failed even though each worked
alone: interp printed the first result then reported `backend value 1 is
unbound`; native run/build reported `artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan` around
absent reducer materialization. The diagnosis was that the first one-element
reduce finishes WITHOUT invoking the captured user reducer, and a later shared
reduce2 activation then needs that reducer lane.

## What is true now

The ticket's own repro works on all three lanes and matches Elixir byte for
byte:

    fn main() do
      dbg(Enum.reduce(1..1, fn (x, acc) -> x * acc end))
      dbg(Enum.reduce(5..1//-2, fn (x, acc) -> x - acc end))
      dbg(Enum.reduce(1..5//2, fn (x, acc) -> x * acc end))
    end

    elixir  => 1 3 15
    interp  => 1 3 15
    run     => 1 3 15
    build   => 1 3 15

No unbound value, no incomplete-semantic-plan.

Closed on the absence of a repro rather than an attributed fix. The ticket
placed itself in the shared-HOF callable materialization family (fz-k22 /
fz-f98.6), and that family saw substantial work in the fz-6gb (brand-blind
library keying) and fz-f98.14.11 (return-lane single authority) arc, either of
which plausibly covers it. If a multi-call Range reduce/2 body breaks again,
file fresh with the new repro.
title: Range Enum.reduce/2 multi-call body loses reducer materialization after one-element reduce finishes without invoking reducer
